_comment: Scenarios for scripts/cu-replay-eval.py against the AcmeDesk fixture app (scripts/cu-fixture). People come from scripts/replay-scenarios.json, so the Mac and the browser replay the same returns. `site` sets the fixture's hard modes; `twice` runs a scenario again right after, to check what the first run learned (the second run's model calls are reported on their own).

scenarios.why: the skill's own data, app unchanged: no model at all
other people: different values, the capital gains part only when needed, 2–3 deduction rows
renamed buttons and fields, new identifiers, fields in another order
every identifier is new on each launch: found by role and label
controls arrive 0.7–2.4s late behind a spinner; Submit takes 2.5s
an unknown “What's new” sheet, and “Stay signed in?” mid-typing that swallows input
the session expires on the way to deductions: sign in again, carry on
the first Submit says “busy, try again”: retry once, never file twice
the window opens at a different place and size
5 deduction rows; a name with ë and an apostrophe; money with commas, “Old”, “24(b)”
Farah's PAN isn't given: Bharat is filed, Farah is reported, not guessed
a “Verify email” screen nobody recorded, a required declaration box, a decoy “Save draft”, a toast with Undo
the app loses Chandra's details before review: replay must notice and ask, not file an empty return
stopped mid-run: nothing after the stop, nothing half-filed
the person pauses, holds the Mac a few seconds, then takes it back: nothing done while paused, everything finished after
